newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends softer on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends softer on profit-taking.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed lower against its U.S. counterpart on Friday with investors taking quick profits off the local currency's sharp rise on Thursday, dealers said.
The unit ended at T$27.894 against Thursday's T$27.855 finish. Turnover through dealers was an active US$326 million.
Dealers said the Philippine peso's shock 11.5 percent plunge was not a factor in Taiwan's market.
Dealers said both commercial demand and speculative buying for the greenback remained strong because of the U.S. unit's expected long-term uptrend against the Taiwan dollar.
